<module id="adder_pipe_64bit">
    <description>64-bit ripple carry adder with pipelining stages.</description>
    <ports>
        <input id="clk">Clock input.</input>
        <input id="rst_n">Active low reset signal.</input>
        <input id="i_en">Enable signal for addition operation.</input>
        <input id="adda" width_description="[63:0]">64-bit input operand A.</input>
        <input id="addb" width_description="[63:0]">64-bit input operand B.</input>
        <output id="result" width_description="[64:0]">65-bit output representing the sum of adda and addb.</output>
        <output id="o_en">Output enable signal.</output>
    </ports>
    <parameter_description>
        <parameter id="PIPE_STAGES">3</parameter>
    </parameter_description>
    <logic_description>
        <reg id="pipe_reg_a[PIPE_STAGES]" type="sequential_logic">Pipeline register for input A.</reg>
        <reg id="pipe_reg_b[PIPE_STAGES]" type="sequential_logic">Pipeline register for input B.</reg>
        <reg id="pipe_carry[PIPE_STAGES]" type="sequential_logic">Pipeline register for carry signals.</reg>
        <reg id="pipe_result[PIPE_STAGES]" type="sequential_logic">Pipeline register for intermediate results.</reg>
        <reg id="o_en_reg" type="sequential_logic">Register for output enable signal.</reg>
    </logic_description>
    <implementation>
        // Pipeline stage 0
        always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
            if (!rst_n) begin
                pipe_reg_a[0] <= 64'd0;
                pipe_reg_b[0] <= 64'd0;
                pipe_carry[0] <= 1'b0;
                pipe_result[0] <= 65'd0;
            end else if (i_en) begin
                pipe_reg_a[0] <= adda;
                pipe_reg_b[0] <= addb;
                pipe_carry[0] <= 1'b0;
                pipe_result[0] <= adda + addb;
            end
        end

        // Pipeline stage 1
        always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
            if (!rst_n) begin
                pipe_reg_a[1] <= 64'd0;
                pipe_reg_b[1] <= 64'd0;
                pipe_carry[1] <= 1'b0;
                pipe_result[1] <= 65'd0;
            end else begin
                pipe_reg_a[1] <= pipe_reg_a[0];
                pipe_reg_b[1] <= pipe_reg_b[0];
                pipe_carry[1] <= pipe_carry[0];
                pipe_result[1] <= pipe_result[0] + {1'b0, pipe_carry[0]};
            end
        end

        // Pipeline stage 2
        always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
            if (!rst_n) begin
                pipe_reg_a[2] <= 64'd0;
                pipe_reg_b[2] <= 64'd0;
                pipe_carry[2] <= 1'b0;
                pipe_result[2] <= 65'd0;
            end else begin
                pipe_reg_a[2] <= pipe_reg_a[1];
                pipe_reg_b[2] <= pipe_reg_b[1];
                pipe_carry[2] <= pipe_carry[1];
                pipe_result[2] <= pipe_result[1] + {1'b0, pipe_carry[1]};
            end
        end

        // Output enable synchronization
        always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
            if (!rst_n) begin
                o_en_reg <= 1'b0;
            end else begin
                o_en_reg <= pipe_carry[2];
            end
        end

        // Final output
        assign result = pipe_result[2];
        assign o_en = o_en_reg;
    </implementation>
</module>
